items.snippet: The macOS Golden Gate 27.2.1 update Apple released today addresses the eMudhra certificate vulnerability, and Apple recommends users update to the latest software. items.snippet: Apple paid more income tax in Ireland than in Singapore in fiscal 2026, but it saved more in Singapore. Apple's annual report shows that the company paid $4.96 billion in cash income taxes in Ireland and $3.25 billion in Singapore. Singapore's lower tax rate and incentives would have saved Apple $5.49 billion before other taxes and adjustments. A $2.51 billion top-up tax erased nearly half of that initial saving.
